const data = $input.first().json;
const allowed = new Set([
  'RADAR_READY',
  'RADAR_FAILED',
  'RADAR_NO_ELIGIBLE_CANDIDATE',
  'RADAR_CONFIGURATION_BLOCKED',
  'RADAR_CATALOG_FAILED',
  'RADAR_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE',
]);
const status = allowed.has(data.status_hint) ? data.status_hint : 'RADAR_FAILED';
return [{
  json: {
    project_key: data.configuration?.project_key ?? 'ia-das-vagas-content-factory',
    workflow_key: data.configuration?.workflow_key ?? 'topic-radar',
    workflow_version: data.configuration?.workflow_version ?? '0.4.16',
    schema_version: data.configuration?.schema_version ?? '1.2.0',
    execution_id: data.execution_id,
    status,
    input: data.input ?? null,
    candidates: status === 'RADAR_READY' ? data.radar_candidates : [],
    evaluated_candidates: [...(data.radar_candidates ?? []), ...(data.radar_rejected_candidates ?? [])].slice(0, Number(data.configuration?.MAX_PORTFOLIO_CANDIDATES ?? 3)),
    rejected_candidates: data.radar_rejected_candidates ?? [],
    summary: data.radar_summary ?? {
      status,
      selected_count: 0,
      rejected_count: 0,
      human_approval_required: false,
      automatic_selection_required: status === 'RADAR_READY',
      article_generation_allowed: false,
      image_generation_allowed: false,
      wordpress_write_allowed: false,
    },
    usage: data.radar_usage ?? null,
    source_audit: data.radar_response ?? null,
    sanitized_error: data.sanitized_error ?? null,
    provider_circuit: data.provider_circuit ?? { provider: 'openai', state: 'CLOSED' },
    warnings: data.warnings ?? [],
    checkpoints: data.checkpoints ?? [],
  },
}];
